name: FLA_SCHEDULE_HEADERS
description: FLA_SCHEDULE_HEADERS contains schedule information at payment line and regime level for each transaction. Transactions can be BOOKING, REVISION, TERMINATION and EXPIRY.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: SCHEDULE_HEADER_ID. This is primary key for the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier. It is referenced from FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the lease as captured in FLA_LEASE_DETAILS.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It is referenced from FLA_LEASES_ALL table to indicate that the schedules header is pertaining to specific lease.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment number. Schedules are generated for this Payment Header.

columns.name: REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Regime code. This drives the accounting model and reporting for the lease.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the amortization schedule starts.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the amortization schedule ends.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_AMORTIZATION_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days between Amortization start and end dates

columns.name: INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Interest rate . It is derived from Discount rate index selected at lease level. This will be the interest rate for the regime.

columns.name: ADDER_RATE
columns.description: Adder rate defined at lease level. This will be the adder rate set for the regime at Lease level.

columns.name: DAILY_COMPOUNDING_RATE
columns.description: Daily compounding interest rate for the Lease.

columns.name: LEASE_EXPENSE_RATE
columns.description: It contains one day expense rate in case of daily and one month rate in case of periodic.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_RATE
columns.description: It contains one day amortization rate in case of daily and one month rate in case of periodic.

columns.name: FORECASTED_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Forecasted Liability Amount for the Payment.

columns.name: FORECASTED_FIN_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Forecasted Financial ROU Amount for the Payment Term.

columns.name: FORECASTED_OPER_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Forecasted Operating ROU Amount for the Payment Term.

columns.name: FORECASTED_RESERVE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Forecasted Reserve Amount for the Payment Term.

columns.name: FORECASTED_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Forecasted Payment Amount for the Payment Term.

columns.name: FORECASTED_INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Forecasted Interest amount for the Payment Term.

columns.name: CLOSING_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Closing liability till amendement commencement date.

columns.name: CLOSING_FIN_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Closing Financial ROU till amendement commencement date.

columns.name: CLOSING_OPER_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Closing Operating ROU till amendement commencement date.

columns.name: CLOSING_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Closing payment till amendement commencement date.

columns.name: CLOSING_INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Closing interest till amendement commencement date.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Adjusted liability as on amendement commencement date.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_FIN_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Adjusted Financial ROU as on amendement commencement date.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_OPER_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Adjusted Operating ROU as on amendement commencement date.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_RESERVE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Adjusted reserve amount for the payment term.

columns.name: GAIN_LOSS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Calculated Gain or Loss as on amendment commencement date.

columns.name: CLOSING_EXPENSE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Closing lease expense amount till amendment commencement date.

columns.name: PRIOR_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Pre-amendment liability amount for the payment term.

columns.name: PRIOR_FIN_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Pre-amendment financial ROU amount for the payment term.

columns.name: PRIOR_OPER_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Pre-amendment operating ROU amount for the payment term.

columns.name: PRIOR_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Pre-amedment payment amount for the payment term.

columns.name: PRIOR_INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Pre-amendment interest amount for the payment term.

columns.name: PRIOR_EXPENSE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Pre-amendment lease expense amount for the payment term.

columns.name: REDUCED_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Reduction in liability amount due to scope reduction.

columns.name: REDUCED_FIN_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Reduction in financial ROU amount due to scope reduction.

columns.name: REDUCED_OPER_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Reduction in operating ROU amount due to scope reduction.

columns.name: REDUCED_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Reduction in payment amount due to scope reduction.

columns.name: REDUCED_INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Reduction in interest amount due to scope reduction.

columns.name: REDUCED_EXPENSE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Reduction in lease expense amount due to scope reduction.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE_OF_REDUCTION
columns.description: Reduction in ROU or Liability. This would be based on reduction in time, usage or liability.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type. Possible values are BOOKING,REVISION or TERMINATION.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction sub type. Possible values are SCOPE_INCREASE, SCOPE_DECREASE, SCOPE_NO_CHANGE, EDIT and so forth for a REVISION transaction type.

columns.name: REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Reversal flag which indicates if the transaction is reversed or pending for reversal.

columns.name: LEASE_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the lease classification. Possible values are Finance Lease, Operating Lease.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_START_DATE
columns.description: Indicates start date of the amendment entries.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the Transaction date. This will be used to derive the Catchup amounts.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate that the accounting is processed.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Active flag. Tells if the schedule header is active or not.

columns.name: PARENT_RECORD_ID
columns.description: It contains parent booking or amendement schedule header primary key.

columns.name: REGENERATE_SCHEDULES_FLAG
columns.description: Regenerate schedules flag. If the flag is set then the schedules need to be regenerated.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_PRORATION_CODE
columns.description: Proration method to identify the number of days to consider per month to prorate the amount

columns.name: LAST_ACCRUED_DATE
columns.description: Date till which the last accrual was run.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: FINAL_FIN_ACCRUED_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Final financial Right of use accrued amount as of closing.

columns.name: FINAL_OPER_ACCRUED_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Final operating Right of use accrued amount as of closing.

columns.name: TRANSFER_BALANCE_FLAG
columns.description: Transfer balance flag indicates if the payment balance or option balance has been transferred to the linked payment.

columns.name: END_OF_TERM_TRANSFER_FLAG
columns.description: End of term transfer flag indicates if the transfer of balance is at the end of the payment or option term.

columns.name: PARENT_TRANSFER_RECORD_ID
columns.description: This stores the parent payment or option record from which transfer of balance was processed.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_TRANSACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Expiration transaction flag indicates if the termination transaction is during an expiration of lease or asset.

columns.name: HEADER_BALANCE_SYNC_DATE
columns.description: Date when the schedule balances were synced up.

columns.name: LAST_PAYMENT_SYNC_DATE
columns.description: Date when the last payment was synced up.

columns.name: LAST_ACCRUAL_SYNC_DATE
columns.description: Date when the last accrual was synced up.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Contingent amount captured for the payment.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_ONLY_IMPACT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates contingent amount is impacted.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version of the schedule generation.

columns.name: TOT_FORECAST_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total forecasted liability amount. This is the unrounded amount.

columns.name: LAST_RECLASS_ACCRUED_DATE
columns.description: Attribute indicating date till which the last liability reclassification was run.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_ID
columns.description: Attribute indicating the Supplier site identifier.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating payment currency code.

columns.name: REVENUE_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the method for spread of generated revenue, valid values are lease revenue and non lease revenue.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of schedule, valid values are PAYMENT and BILLING.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer identifier for the billing.

columns.name: BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Ship to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: SCOPE_CHANGE_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Scope change method for the lease. Values can be Unit based percentage and Liability based percentage.

columns.name: UNITS_CONSUMED
columns.description: Number of units of the asset being considered on lease.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute indicating unit of measure used for the asset.

columns.name: LAST_PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: Last date of the payment. This is derived based on the payment lines.

columns.name: END_OF_DAY_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the present value to be calculated at the end of the day for the payment.

columns.name: INTEREST_COMPOUNDING_DAYS
columns.description: Number of interest compounding days.

columns.name: SIMPLE_INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Simple interest rate derived based on discount rate provided.

columns.name: INTEREST_COMPOUNDING_CODE
columns.description: Interest compounding method. Possible values are DAILY and MONTHLY.

columns.name: FIN_ROU_GROSS_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Finance right of use gross balance amount for migrated leases.

columns.name: OPER_ROU_GROSS_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Operating right of use gross balance amount for migrated leases.

columns.name: FINANCE_ACCUM_AMORT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Finance right of use accumulated amortization amount for migrated leases.

columns.name: OPERATING_ACCUM_AMORT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Operating right of use accumulated amortization amount for migrated leases.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
